CurationRun@v1 is the governance contract for material curation summaries. Curation currently reaches the spine as security_research_spine contributions (kind llm_llm_curation) without this lineage. Wiring it means scheduling governed LLM curation runs, which spends paid model budget: operator decision (AGENTS.md section 17).

A second autonomous truth -> CIO -> notify -> memory loop. The office cycle runs through cio_run and the wake lanes (cio_wake_jobs.jsonl, workflow-lineage CIO_GENERATION nodes). Wiring this one would create a competing cycle.
